title: Memory preserved outside the pool
statement: Let $W$ be a word width, $N\in\bbn$, and let $m:\bbr\to\text{BitVec}(W)$ be a memory. The pool-initialization program sets the pool cell at index $0$ and then fills the cells at indices $1$ through $N$; after executing it, the resulting memory agrees with $m$ at every integer address outside the set of pool addresses $-(25+4n)$ for $0\le n\le N$.
